final: WITH account_stats AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_signed_amount, transaction_count, transaction_count / (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM account_stats) AS transaction_count_ratio FROM account_stats ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
